newsitem.title: USA: Alco Standard sees $10 bln revs in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Alco Standard sees $10 bln revs in 1997.

text.p: Alco Standard Corp said Thursday that with the continued growth in IKON's Office Solutions traditional copier business, and increasing contributions from outsourcing and technology services businesses, it expected earnings per share for fiscal 1997 to be 35 to 40 percent ahead of last year.
"Our goal is to reach $10 billion in revenue by the year 2000, and we are well on our way," the company said.

Earlier, the comapny reported income in the first quarter of fiscal year 1997 (ended December 31, 1996) from its continuing operation, IKON Office Solutions, was $45 million, excluding a one-time, extraordinary charge from the early extinguishment of debt.

The income results are a 21 percent increase over the first quarter of the previous fiscal year. Earnings per share from continuing operations for the quarter, excluding the charge, were $0.30, a 20 percent gain over the same period of fiscal 1996, despite a 13 percent increase in average shares outstanding. Including the charge, income from continuing operations was $33 million and earnings per share from continuing operations were $0.21.
